Nereus (tradipitant) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-642235  
Guideline Name 
Nereus (tradipitant)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
7/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Nereus  
Approval Length 
1 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Used for the short-term prevention of vomiting induced by motion  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  


--- PDF page 1235 ---
Page 1235 
 
AND 
 
3 - Dosing frequency will be limited to once daily dosing  
 
AND 
 
4 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims confirming 
trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to two conventional motion sickness therapies 
including but not limited to the following: environmental modification, transdermal scopolamine 
and antihistamines (e.g., dimenhydrinate, meclizine)  
 
AND 
 
5 - Requested drug is not being prescribed for off-label use (e.g., drug induced nausea and 
vomiting, morning sickness, vertigo)  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
6/25/2026  
New program
